110: This is a proper claim - and even without extension [of an oath], if he would have partially conceded or if there was one witness, he would be obligated to take an oath, since his claim [that he is a Hebrew slave and thus owes him] labor or deduction [for years not served] is a claim regarding movable objects. In what sense is this beyond other cases of extension of an oath?
He himself is acquired - and this is not a claim regarding movable property.
